channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jahlil Okafor | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jahlil Okafor from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Brown did admit that Dallas Mavericks small forward Wes Iwundu and Detroit Pistons center Jahlil Okafor are two of the names under consideration.

“I have been talking to Wes, Jahlil; he has been to Nigeria and spent some time there when he was 11, 12 years old. He's a guy that I am excited about. We all should be excited about a guy like Jahlil because of his talent and his ability on that low post,”

Mike Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Mar 20, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Weaver speaking broadly on what Okafor and Plumlee bring:

“I think they fit today’s game. Today’s game is all about getting to the rim and 3’s. These guys score at the rim very well. Mason’s passing is exceptional. Jahlil’s offensive rebounding is exceptional.”

Troy Weaver on Jahlil Okafor, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Mike Krzyzewski on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Mike Krzyzewski:

“We all go through things when were 18, 22—some of us do it the rest of our lives—that are new, and if we’re not in a structure or environment that can help us more. Not saying the Sixers didn’t. It’s on Jahlil. He didn’t have that. He made mistakes that he would never make. That happens all the time. I see it all the time, not just athletes but kids on campus. They have freedom. It’s their first time away from home. In his case, you’ve get money.”

Mike Krzyzewski on Jahlil Okafor, May 8, 2020. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Oleh Kosel:Alvin Gentry on Jahlil Okafor today:

“I think you'll see him soon. Obviously, we're in a situation now where we're depleted from a big guy standpoint. He's worked extremely hard, I'll tell you that. He's worked as hard as anybody every single day he comes in here.”

Alvin Gentry on Jahlil Okafor, Dec 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jahlil Okafor, Jarrett Allen
item.description:
Kerber asked Atkinson if Okafor's presence would mean less time for Allen.

“No. (We could play) Jarrett and Okafor together. Put Okafor at the 5,”

Kenny Atkinson on Jahlil Okafor, Jarrett Allen, Dec 30, 2017. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
And head coach Kenny Atkinson gave two reasons why after 109-97 loss.

“I talked to Jahlil. I had a great conversation with him. We need to help him get in better condition, first off”

Kenny Atkinson on Jahlil Okafor, Dec 18, 2017. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Molly French:Brett Brown on the trade:

“I'm happy for Jahlil and Nik. They're going into a good situation to get more of an opportunity to get on the court.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Dec 7, 2017. Source: Twitter @MollySullivanTV.

item.title: Sean Marks on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
“We are excited about the prospects of both Jahlil and Nik, as well as adding another future asset which will aid us in our continued roster development,”

Sean Marks on Jahlil Okafor, Dec 7, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Bill Duffy on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
“The Sixers are positioned well for the present and the future, and we only want the same for Jahlil.”

Bill Duffy on Jahlil Okafor, Nov 27, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Brown said after the 101-81 win against Portland.

“I say that out of respect to [Okafor]. I don’t think that puts him in a position that I want to put him in.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Nov 23, 2017. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
“So, you are just always communicating with him. You are telling him your thoughts and … at the end of the day, help[ing] Jahlil.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Nov 10, 2017. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Bryan Colangelo on Okafor:

“We will continue to grow him to where he needs to be. If a deal comes a long that makes sense for both, we'll listen.”

Bryan Colangelo on Jahlil Okafor, Apr 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Colangelo:

“Quite frankly Jahlil's got the same issue that Nerlens has. He wants to play somewhere, he wants to start at the end of the day I'm hopeful that at some point he can find that.”

Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor, Feb 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brown on if all Okafor trade talks are off:

“I don’t believe they’re off. I think this particular one has not happened.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Feb 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brown:

“The one that was the reason for us reacting to Jahlil not being with the team, very advanced discussions, did not happen.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Feb 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brett Brown:

“Jahlil Okafor’s situation is transparent. He’s in the middle of being discussed in trade scenarios. I felt it complicates things to play him the last game & now clearly this is continuing on. That’s the reason he isn’t here.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Feb 13, 2017. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Brian Seltzer:Colangelo:

“I have to complement Nerlens, Jahlil on way they've handled everything. Acting like true professionals. Both have been great.”

Bryan Colangelo on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor, Feb 9, 2017. Source: Twitter @brianseltzer.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor's minutes:

“With Jahlil, that is more fluid. His situation, I believe, is going to be in a position to increase.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Nov 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Brett Brown said after practice Monday.

“This particular one, given Jahlil’s sort of infant stages into becoming healthier, we’re going to not use up his minutes tomorrow night and then spend our money more in Charlotte.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Oct 31, 2016. Source: CSNPhilly.com.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor:

“Increase in minutes I think is a reflection he is moving in direction we all want, and I expect those minutes to go up.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Oct 29, 2016. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Joel Embiid on Jahlil Okafor:

“I think it’s going to be exciting... We’re figuring out how to play w/ each other. It’s a process and we’ve got trust it.”

Joel Embiid on Jahlil Okafor, Oct 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Nerlens Noel on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Nerlens Noel:

“I want to really emphasize how much I love my guys. Jahlil and Joel are prob. some of my closer friends on this team that I have.”

Nerlens Noel on Jahlil Okafor, Sep 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Jessica Camerato:Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor:

“It's just a significant bruise at this stage. It's not something that we're overly concerned with.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Mar 6, 2016. Source: Twitter @JCameratoCSN.

item.title: Sam Hinkie on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Bob Cooney:Sam Hinkie:

“A fair bit of interest (in Okafor and Noel at trade deadline).They understand that we were much more likely to keep them.”

Sam Hinkie on Nerlens Noel, Jahlil Okafor, Feb 19, 2016. Source: Twitter @BobCooney76.

item.title: Sam Hinkie on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Brian Seltzer:Sam Hinkie on Jahlil Okafor:

“He was 19 years old scoring 19 points per game. I think he'll be just fine.”

Sam Hinkie on Jahlil Okafor, Jan 13, 2016. Source: Twitter @brianseltzer.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
“The people that know Jahlil would all say that he's a good person, he screwed up & is ashamed and embarrassed by it”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Dec 4, 2015. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Afterward, Anthony – whose character was called into question early in his career – said he can provide Okafor with perspective to overcome these issues.

“I just know how much a voice can help. In Okafor’s situation, it’s easy for people to kind of turn their backs on him in this moment. Especially with him so young, the team not being successful – them losing games over there,”

Carmelo Anthony on Jahlil Okafor, Dec 3, 2015. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Stefan Bondy:Brett Brown on Okafor:

“I’m looking at a 19-year-old kid that has all of a sudden come upon money and has been used to winning.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Dec 2, 2015. Source: Twitter @SBondyNYDN.

item.title: Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
Howard Beck:Brett Brown on Okafor:

“We will support him. He is ours. And we will move on.”

Brett Brown on Jahlil Okafor, Dec 2, 2015. Source: Twitter @HowardBeck.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Jahlil Okafor
item.description:
said an Eastern Conference scout.

“Okafor is just not athletic. He’s not going to be a rim protector. Towns is more mobile and athletic. I don’t know if he’ll shoot an NBA three-pointer, but he’ll have much better range.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Jahlil Okafor, Apr 6, 2015. Source: Sports Illustrated.
